summary: Layout: the committed composed top-level stream. It is produced by the committed klt flows (layout/*/bin/run-flow.sh, layout/sar-adc-top/bin/) with a per-flow record, and this envelope pins its bytes. It asserts the stream exists and is the one items 3 and 11 cite; it asserts nothing about item 4 (top-level LVS mismatches stay tracked by #103). Its sar_sequencer macro was routed from layout/sar-sequencer/netlist/sar_sequencer.v as committed, which item 1 (digital) reports as stale against the schematic.
